desc:
✈️ WAIT… I CAN FLY TO CHINA IN ROBLOX?! 🐼

Pack your bags! Your dream trip from Los Angeles to Shanghai starts HERE! 🌏

🧳 Check in, drop off your luggage, and pass through airport security.
🛫 Board a widebody aircraft and enjoy your flight to China!
🏨 Explore hotels, lobbies, and guest rooms.
👥 Travel with friends, meet new people, and create your own RP stories!
🏙️ Explore Shanghai’s famous landmarks and attractions!
🚄 Hop on a high-speed train and ride a full loop around China! (BETA)

Explore, relax, socialize, and enjoy the ultimate airport adventure!

🌟 MORE DESTINATIONS COMING SOON!

👍 Enjoying the game? Please leave a like and add it to your Favorites!

NEXT STOP: CHINA! 🇨🇳
